steps.title: Bem-vindo: Listening - Volume 28
steps.text: In this B2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Listening". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: She has a strong Scottish accent.
There's too much background noise to hear clearly.
She talks fast, just like a native speaker.

steps.text: It means: "To start a conversation in order to relieve tension.". Say the example sentence out loud:
